name: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth
description: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth is an account-level application identity that lets a private server call selected Zoom APIs without an interactive user authorization flow.
agentUseSummary: This account credential pattern is visible as a canonical Zoom provider extension preview. Relay will not collect a customer's Zoom app secret or create a parallel account-wide token and tool surface beside the canonical Zoom connector.

capabilities.label: Use account-level Zoom automation
capabilities.description: If customer-managed account credentials are approved, extend the canonical Zoom connector with an exact account, app, scope and token-lifecycle binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Zoom provider state
blocked.description: A server-to-server listing must not create a parallel token, tool or approval surface beside Relay's canonical Zoom connector.

blocked.label: Capture Zoom application credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an account administrator to paste a client secret, client ID or account ID into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Create or activate a Zoom server app
blocked.description: Creating, activating, rotating or deactivating the account's Server-to-Server OAuth app is an administrator operation outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Grant unbounded account-level access
blocked.description: Server-to-Server OAuth can act across data in the owning Zoom account; Relay will not request broad scopes or bypass account role controls.

blocked.label: Run Zoom actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; any approved account-level mode must reuse the canonical Zoom connector's typed tools, policies and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: Zoom account automation security review
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Account-level credentials remain unavailable until the canonical Zoom connector has a least-privilege, revocable server-to-server design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; account-level credentials must extend the canonical Zoom provider pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; account-level credentials must extend the canonical Zoom provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth is a non-interactive, account-level credential that can exercise every API permission granted to its private app. Relay does not support customer-owned Zoom secrets or a second Zoom token and tool surface.
providerSetup.nextAction: Prefer Relay-owned OAuth on the canonical Zoom connector. For an approved account-level case, extend that connector with immutable account and app binding, least-privilege scopes, administrator evidence, short-lived token handling, credential rotation, IP restrictions where available, revocation and the existing typed action policies.

evidence.supports: Zoom describes Server-to-Server OAuth as a non-interactive access-token flow for private server applications using scopes granted by account owners, and requires administrator role permissions for developers.
Zoom's current app build flow requires explicit API scopes and states minimal access is a key security principle.
Zoom publishes granular endpoint-specific OAuth scopes, including administrative Marketplace operations that must not be exposed through this alias.
Zoom documents account-level data reach for administrative app permissions and an administrator-controlled IP allow list for server-to-server apps.
